description: Flood Protection Works - Structural Works is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Management. Existing flood protection works (dikes and bank protection) crest alignment in British Columbia. Updated from available Provincial dike crest survey project data from 2019/2020. If 2019/2020 dike survey project data is unavailable, linework based on previous data from 2004 and prior. May include periodic updates depending on data provided by Diking Authorities and other sources. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Management. Its tags are dike, diking authority, flood protection works, levee. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
